response.overview: Benny Lipman is a young Jewish gangster rising through 1930s NYC’s mob scene alongside notorious figures including Meyer Lansky, Bugsy Siegel, and Lucky Luciano. When breaking up local Nazi rallies isn't enough, Benny devises a daring plan to infiltrate Germany and assassinate Hitler by luring him into an art gallery—and even persuades his bosses to back the mission.
response.title: The Hit on Hitler
